# Hågen Sagli

> Hågen Sagli (also written Haagen Sagli or Hagen Sagli; full name Hågen Moe Sagli) is a Calgary-based finance professional working in corporate development and quantitative finance. McGill Master of Finance (MMF) graduate and founder of SPC Capital Inc.

## About

- Name: Hågen Moe Sagli
- Also written: Haagen Sagli, Hagen Sagli, Hågen Moe Sagli, Haagen Moe Sagli
- Location: Calgary, Alberta, Canada
- Role: Finance professional — corporate development and quantitative finance
- Education: McGill University (Master of Finance, MMF); Mount Royal University
- Founder of: SPC Capital Inc. (systematic quantitative trading)

## Focus areas

- Quantitative finance and systematic trading
- Corporate development
- Canadian energy markets
- Financial modeling
